take_homes: Before an agent touches anything real, ask three things: what can it read, what can it change, and what must go back to a person.
The safest fix is not to connect the agent to the system or mailbox at all. It costs a feature, but it is cheap.
If the agent's check leaves a doubt, take one narrow question to legal or IT.

monday.stop_condition: I would only try it if one step solved a real reporting pain for the depots. Nothing in this module did.
monday.blocker: No time. The reporting lives in a system I can't export from without IT.

misconception.why: I still think AI is a chatbot for customers. Nothing here used a shift plan or a delivery report. The 'door you don't open' idea made sense, but it didn't change what I think AI is for.

one_line: Too much reading in English and a lot of copy-paste filler. Only the 'which doors do you open' part was useful, and it was nothing I could use at the depot.
